name: codex-windows-toast
description: Show a Windows toast when a Codex CLI turn ends.

interface.shortDescription: Show the current prompt and finished Codex reply.
interface.longDescription: Sends a native Windows toast after the main Codex CLI agent finishes a turn, using the current user prompt as the title and the final assistant message as the body.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether Codex Windows Toast is installed correctly.
